title: Air India Suspends Tel Aviv-Delhi Flights Through September as Middle East Tensions Persist
excerpt: The suspension extends Air India's pause on its only direct Israel route, affecting thousands of Indian workers and diaspora travelers with ties to the region.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Air India has suspended its Tel Aviv-Delhi flights through September 2026.
  • The route has been inactive since late 2025 due to military tensions.
  • Approximately 18,000 Indian workers in Israel are affected by the suspension.
  • Passengers must now transit through Gulf hubs, increasing travel time and costs.
  • The suspension impacts Indian-origin residents and business travelers as well.

Air India has extended the suspension of its Tel Aviv-Delhi flights through the end of September, the airline confirmed — prolonging a gap in direct air connectivity between India and Israel that has persisted for nearly a year as Middle East tensions show no sign of easing.

The Route

Air India's Tel Aviv-Delhi service was the sole nonstop connection between the two countries. The airline suspended operations on the route in late 2025 amid escalating military conflict in the region, and has repeatedly extended the pause as security conditions have failed to improve.

The latest extension through September suggests the airline sees no near-term path to resumption. Air India has not indicated what conditions would need to be met for the route to restart.

> **"The Route Air India's Tel Aviv-Delhi service was the sole nonstop connection between the two countries."**

Who's Affected

The suspension hits hardest for the estimated 18,000 Indian workers in Israel — many employed in construction, agriculture, and caregiving under bilateral labor agreements. Without a direct flight, these workers must transit through Gulf hubs like Dubai or Doha, or route via Istanbul, adding significant time and cost to journeys home.

Indian-origin residents of Israel, business travelers supporting the growing India-Israel technology and defence partnerships, and tourists planning pilgrimages to the Holy Land are also affected. The lack of direct connectivity has pushed many to rely on El Al, the Israeli carrier, or Gulf airlines — options that are often more expensive and involve longer routings.

Broader Context

Several international airlines have similarly suspended or reduced service to Tel Aviv as the regional security situation remains volatile. The airspace around Israel and parts of the eastern Mediterranean has been subject to periodic closures and restrictions, complicating flight planning even for carriers willing to operate.

For India's diaspora community with ties to Israel — a relationship that has deepened through defence cooperation, technology partnerships, and agricultural exchanges over the past two decades — the flight suspension is a tangible reminder of how geopolitical instability disrupts the everyday connections that bind diaspora lives together.

Air India has offered rebooking options and refunds for affected passengers. The airline said it continues to monitor the situation and will provide updates on resumption when conditions allow.
